annotations.title: Audit DCAA Pre-Award Accounting System (SF 1408) & Indirect Rate Pools

description: Audit a contractor's chart of accounts, indirect cost pool structure (Fringe, Overhead, G&A, B&P/IR&D), timekeeping procedures, labor distribution policy, and general ledger setup against the 18-point DCAA Standard Form 1408 (SF 1408) Pre-Award Accounting System Checklist, FAR 16.301-3, FAR Subpart 31.2, and DFARS 252.242-7006, returning an SF 1408 executive readiness overview, a line-by-line SF 1408 checklist audit, an indirect rate pool and allocation base analysis, a FAR 31.205 unallowable cost segregation assessment (with FAR 52.242-3 penalty risk), labor timekeeping and DCAA floor-check controls, and a pre-award survey remediation roadmap. This is a read-only, stateless, non-destructive GovCon accounting and compliance audit call (requires X-RapidAPI-Key; `chart_of_accounts_and_pools_text` accepts 20 to 45,000 characters, while `target_contract_type_and_solicitation` and `accounting_software_and_erp_stack` calibrate audit criteria across CPFF, CPIF, CPAF, T&M, and FFP contracts on Deltek Costpoint, Unanet, QuickBooks + GovCon timekeeping, or NetSuite). Use this tool when preparing for a DCAA SF 1408 Pre-Award Accounting System Survey, validating Fringe/Overhead/G&A pool-to-base causal/beneficial relationships, or segregating FAR 31.205 unallowable costs; use `generate_igce_price_to_win` instead to model proposal CLIN wrap-rate pricing and Price-to-Win sensitivity, or `extract_pricing_schedule` to parse Section B CLIN tables.

accounting_software_and_erp_stack.description: Current accounting ERP & timekeeping stack (e.g., Deltek Costpoint, Unanet GovCon, QuickBooks + ICAT/BigTime, NetSuite; defaults to 'QuickBooks_Online_With_GovCon_Timekeeping').

chart_of_accounts_and_pools_text.description: Contractor's chart of accounts, indirect cost pool structure (Fringe, Overhead, G&A, B&P/IR&D), timekeeping procedures, labor distribution policy, and general ledger setup (20 to 45,000 characters).

target_contract_type_and_solicitation.description: Target contract type (CPFF, CPIF, CPAF, T&M, FFP) and solicitation SF 1408 / FAR 16.301-3 adequacy requirements (defaults to 'Cost_Plus_Fixed_Fee_CPFF_And_T_And_M').

name: audit_dcaa_accounting_sf1408

far_31_205_unallowable_cost_segregation.description: Audit of FAR 31.205 expressly unallowable cost account segregation and FAR 52.242-3 penalty protection controls.

indirect_rate_pool_and_base_analysis.description: Indirect cost pool (Fringe, Overhead, G&A, B&P/IR&D) and allocation base audit under FAR 31.201-4 and CAS 418/410.

labor_timekeeping_and_floor_check_contro.description: Evaluation of daily labor timekeeping, supervisor approvals, Total Time Accounting (TTA), and DCAA floor-check readiness.

pre_award_survey_remediation_roadmap.description: Ordered pre-audit action items and artifact checklist to pass the DCAA SF 1408 Pre-Award Accounting System Survey.

sf1408_18_point_checklist.description: Line-by-line audit of Standard Form 1408 Section II accounting system adequacy criteria with findings and remediation steps.

sf1408_executive_overview.description: Executive DCAA SF 1408 readiness verdict, compliance score (0-100), cost-reimbursable award eligibility, and summary.

title: Audit DCAA Pre-Award Accounting System (SF 1408) & Indirect Rate Pools
